fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank within the term by APY (ties share a rank), after dropping rates below the floor

fields.name: apy_pct
fields.description: Annual percentage yield posted by the institution, percent

fields.name: min_deposit
fields.description: Stated minimum opening deposit in dollars, blank if not stated

fields.name: promotion
fields.description: yes if the institution's own page marks it as a special, promotion or limited-time rate

fields.name: product_note
fields.description: Special product type if any (for example no-penalty or bump-up)

fields.name: ncua_charter
fields.description: NCUA charter number for credit unions

fields.name: remote_opening
fields.description: yes if the institution's website offers an online application (who may use it not yet checked); states: XX, YY if online applications are limited to residents of those states; nationwide if any US resident may apply; local if limited to its market area; no if the institution says in person only; otherwise not stated

fields.name: nonresident_eligible
fields.description: What the institution's own pages say about customers who are not US residents

fields.name: cu_membership_open_nationwide
fields.description: For credit unions, whether anyone in the US can join (usually through a partner organization)

fields.name: early_withdrawal_penalty
fields.description: Early withdrawal penalty as stated, abridged

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The institution's page where the rate was read

fields.name: read_note
fields.description: How the rate was read when it needed a person (for example a browser read or a homepage banner)
